protocol.encoder: Frozen SpatialBallVerifier ResNet18 stride4;64px and192px crops resized128; center plus global pooled features.
protocol.temporal_input: Camera-affine-aligned frames -3,0,+3; concatenate center features and signed neighbor differences; initialize added weights to zero.
protocol.training: Only classifier heads updated. Balanced16positive+16negative batches,8steps per epoch; AdamW weight_decay.01; no labels from evaluation games.
protocol.selection: Development F1, then fewer false positives; threshold ties prefer higher threshold; epoch ties retain earlier epoch. Compare image and temporal heads using this development criterion, simplicity as final tie break.
protocol.test_scope: Later same-game proposals use teacher verdicts, not independent truth. Transfer uses previously opened fixed new-game points, exploratory only.
